```json
{"rows": [
{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a simple Lightning web component board\" that \"renders the 10x10 grid... and has a New game button\"; loading and error states are polish of that requested interface."},
{"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"SLBtlHo9a87Controller has @AuraEnabled public static methods newGame(Integer seed) and fire(...)\" and \"SLBtlHo9a87Engine is a public class with static methods only\"."},
{"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a game is a JSON string\" and \"Create no other metadata (no custom objects, fields...)\", so the board holds the returned game in memory."},
{"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "The board must \"fire at a cell when a person clicks it\"; overlapping requests could submit a stale game or fire a duplicate shot that throws, so input is held until each response returns."},
{"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Build a single-player Battleship game in Apex\" with \"a custom tab... that is a Lightning component tab\"."},
{"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"the computer places a fleet on a 10x10 grid (rows and columns 0 to 9)\"."},
{"n": 7, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a permission set permissionsets/SLBtlHo9a87_Access...\", \"never ask for, print or store credentials\" and out-of-range shots \"throws SLBtlHo9a87Engine.InvalidShotException\"."},
{"n": 8, "label": "implied", "why": "If invalid-shot or server errors were not shown on the board or in test output, failures would be hidden from the player and from whoever runs the tests."},
{"n": 9, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Create no other metadata\" and \"The Salesforce DX project root (sfdx-project.json and force-app/) is the current directory itself\"."},
{"n": 10, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Keep the engine efficient enough that a whole game of 100 shots... runs inside one transaction\"."},
{"n": 11, "label": "implied", "why": "Keyboard focus and contrast make the requested clickable board grid usable; this is accessibility rigour on a requested interface."}
]}
```
